title: Wall Street Analysts Believe ON Semiconductor Corp. (ON) Could Rally 29.15%: Here's is How to Trade
author: Zacks.Com
description: ON Semiconductor (ON) has a mean analyst price target of $95.08, suggesting 29.2% upside potential from its current price of $73.62. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, supported by positive earnings estimate revisions with 11 upward adjustments in the past month. However, the article cautions that price targets alone should not drive investment decisions, as analysts often set overly optimistic targets due to business incentives.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company received a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with a mean analyst price target of $95.08 indicating 29.2% upside potential. Strong agreement among analysts on positive earnings estimate revisions (11 upward revisions, no negative revisions in the past month) and a 2.2% increase in consensus estimates support near-term price appreciation potential.

title: ON Semiconductor Corporation (ON) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It

title: SYNA Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss on Weak Demand
author: Na
description: Synaptics reported Q1 fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $1.26 per share, up 15.6% YoY and beating consensus estimates, but revenues grew only 0.5% to $294 million, missing expectations. The company expanded its Edge AI portfolio with new product launches but withheld forward guidance due to its pending all-cash acquisition by onsemi. Supply constraints, memory-related demand challenges, and smartphone weakness continue to pressure revenues.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed results with EPS beat (+15.6% YoY) and margin expansion, but revenue miss and flat growth. Positive Edge AI momentum offset by near-term headwinds including supply constraints and smartphone weakness. Pending acquisition creates uncertainty and lack of forward guidance.

Acquiring Synaptics in an all-cash deal (restructured from all-stock on Oct. 1, 2026). No direct performance data provided, but acquisition of a company with Edge AI capabilities and margin expansion could be strategically positive, though integration risks exist.
